Perks & builds

Build ideas

Four experiments, each with a reason to try it.

Vintage Racer + CARRY ON

DRIFTAGE holds speed and angle in DRIFT; CARRY ON reduces LOCK drag. Try linked slides on HARBOR. The challenge is banking the slide before the next wall.

Race Car + TORQUE

APEX GRIP improves control and acceleration during OVERCHARGE; TORQUE builds the tank and strengthens KICK. Catch charge before a useful AIRPORT exit.

Rally Racer + CLEAN EXIT

TWITCHY TURNY refills quickly; CLEAN EXIT helps steering after a clean slide. Try short refill-and-burst cycles on CLIFFSIDE.

Future Racer + FULL TANK

OVERDRIVE rewards fast, clean driving; FULL TANK grows and fills the short base tank. Keep the line tidy on fast sections. A collision undermines the clean-driving plan.
